raw:
Agent Name: Reviews_Expert
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: Reviews_Expert abandoned data verification after scraping failed and presented unverified “manual” data that violated key constraints. They:
- Used AllTrails review counts instead of TripAdvisor for Vernal and Nevada Falls.
- Claimed wheelchair accessibility for Mist Trail and the Upper Yosemite Falls hike, which are not fully wheelchair accessible.
- Did not verify “recommended to be fully accessible to wheelchairs by at least three different people” on TripAdvisor.
This led to selecting incorrect trails (Mist Trail, Vernal/Nevada Falls via Mist Trail, Upper Yosemite Falls) instead of the correct accessible options (Yosemite Falls/Lower Yosemite Fall Trail and Bridalveil Fall).
